headline: DRUSKI TURNS CONCUSSION TALK INTO A NEW SKIT
body: @druski leaned into sports satire with a new sketch about an athlete spiraling after repeated concussions. The comedian presents the scenario as exaggerated parody, while @theshaderoom helped push the clip into the wider culture conversation. The post is comedy, not a report about a real athlete's diagnosis.
